```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(performance)
library(see)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmtest)
library(robustlmm)

d1 <- read.csv('Scale_D1_Final.csv')
d1$X <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Dataset 1 only

d1$Explanation.Type <- as.factor(d1$Explanation.Type)
d1$QuestionID <- as.factor(d1$Question.ID)
d1$Participant <- as.factor(d1$Participant)

model_d1_alt <- lmer(Total.Score ~ Explanation.Type +
       (1 | Participant) + 
      (1 | QuestionID),
     data = d1)


summary(model_d1_alt)
confint(model_d1_alt)
icc(model_d1_alt, by_group = TRUE)
```



Check Normality of residuals
```{r}
library(lattice)
qqmath(model_d1_alt)

#Add formal test
shapiro.test(resid(model_d1_alt)) #Shapiro Wilkes is insignificant so this is good!
```
Look at Homogeneity of Variance
```{r}
plot(fitted(model_d1_alt), resid(model_d1_alt))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

library(car)
leveneTest(residuals(model_d1_alt) ~ d1$Explanation.Type)
```
Test for Normality of Random Effects Participant
```{r}
re <- ranef(model_d1_alt)$Participant[, 1]
qqnorm(re)
qqline(re)
shapiro.test(re)

library(lattice)
dotplot(ranef(model_d1_alt, condVar = TRUE))
```
Test for Normality of Random Effects Question ID
```{r}
re <- ranef(model_d1_alt)$QuestionID[, 1]
qqnorm(re)
qqline(re)
shapiro.test(re)

library(lattice)
dotplot(ranef(model_d1_alt, condVar = TRUE))
```
